tickets.title: Move shared modules into src/core and add an import check test
tickets.goal: Move the four modules that feature folders share into src/core/ (src/core/a.js, src/core/b.js, src/core/index.js, src/core/routes.js), update every import in src/ and test/, and add test/imports.test.js, which fails when one feature folder imports another. Read with the file tools, and run only the three verification commands exactly as given, from the product root.
acceptance: No file under src/features/<a>/ imports a file under src/features/<b>/ for a different feature b
The moved modules live in src/core/ and their tests in test/core/; no other module changes behavior
test/imports.test.js reads every .js file under src/, fails with the offending file and import, and has at least one case proving it reports a violation
docs/design.md names test/imports.test.js as the enforcement of the import rule
npm run format:check exits 0, npm run lint reports no issue, npm test passes
tickets.commitMessage: refactor: T-1 move shared modules into src/core and add an import check test

rules.text: No secret, key, token or password is written in code, configuration or test data; secrets come from the environment or a secret store.
Input from outside the process is validated before use and never reaches a shell, a query or HTML without parameters or escaping.
Every new or changed entry point checks who the caller is and what it may do before it acts.
A new or upgraded dependency is named by the ticket, pinned, and comes from the package's official registry.
The change follows the ADRs of this checklist; a departure is named in the report with an ADR draft.
A module reaches another only through that module's public interface, and the change adds no dependency cycle between modules.
A database migration applies to the existing data and can be rolled back, or the ticket says why not.
Lint, test and type-check configuration is not weakened: no rule disabled, threshold lowered or test skipped unless the ticket asks for it.
